# ReleaseKit-Swift

Native iOS 17+ changelog with release voting. Swift 6, no third-party dependencies. Development preview, branch main; no stable 1.0.0 release.

- Package: https://github.com/adamkvcs95/ReleaseKit-Swift
- Configure once: ReleaseKit.configure(appKey: "rk_pub_…")
- Sheet: .releaseKitChangelog(isPresented: $showUpdates)
- Navigation: ReleaseKitChangelogView() / ReleaseKitSettingsLink()
- Full instructions: README.md and AGENTS.md
- Offline cache and App Attest are not implemented; comments remain experimental and disabled in production.
